snippet.title: Qisah Tactics: Prelude to Deleverance Gameplay Footage
snippet.description: Choose between the Demon faction or the Beastman faction to push back the invading Humans in a race against time. The player must move their units forward and push back the invaders towards their Bastion. Along the way the player will encounter Outposts, Mines and Lumberyards for them to capture and build up their resources.
